# NKE — Technicals

## TL;DR

As of May 5, 2026 (run `20260505_220625`), NKE remains in a confirmed downtrend but ADX has dropped from 27.57 to 23.96 — now below the 25 threshold, weakening the trend signal. EMA cascade is fully bearish on both daily and hourly. Price $43.09 is below every EMA from 10 through 200. RSI-7 at 18.35 is deeply oversold — wiki veto on shorting here is confirmed; the Apr 14 loss (-$35.70) was triggered by an identical RSI extreme. MACD histogram has turned slightly positive (+0.3007), signaling downside momentum deceleration. Wait for bounce to 10/21 EMA zone ($44.55–$45.74) for the clean short entry.

## Setup type

**No trade — wait for bounce to $44.55–$45.74 EMA zone.** RSI-7 at 18.35 recreates the exact Apr 14 oversold extreme that led to a -$35.70 loss (insider-buying bounce). MACD histogram turning positive confirms downside deceleration. Shorting at current price: R/R 0.62:1 (target $42.09 = 1.0 pts gain, stop $44.69 Fib 78.6% = 1.6 pts risk) — fails 2:1 minimum. Bouncing long: R/R 1.6:1 — also fails. Neither direction clears the bar at $43.09. Set alert at $44.55 (10 EMA).
